_notes.title: The game's name, in the header and on every platform.
_notes.menu.goal: Accuracy goal shown on a mode button
_notes.menu.goal_met: Hover text on a button whose goal is met
_notes.label.shared: Hover text of one circle that is both a capital and a region (Rome, Vatican City)
_notes.zoom.full: Text on the button that shows the whole map
_notes.skip.next: Hover text of the skip button
_notes.skip.prev: Hover text of the back button
_notes.skip.next_icon: Arrow on the skip button (right arrow)
_notes.skip.prev_icon: Arrow on the back button (left arrow)
_notes.prompt.find: What to find: just the name of the region or city (no "Find:", it is clear from the game).
_notes.feedback.not_main: A far-away part (island, Alaska...) was clicked for its country
_notes.menu.default_only: On a map that isn't translated into the chosen language. {default} is the default language, named in itself.
_notes.menu.default_only_hint: Hover text of that note. {language} is the chosen language.
_notes.board.us_capitals: Scoreboard names: a map, then a game mode.
_notes.package.countries: The names of the zips of maps, shown in Kolibri.
_notes.kit.menu: On the website only: the link at the start of the header back to the page listing the sets of maps (the kit's word, "Menu" by default). Not the game's own map menu.
_notes.kit.menu_heading: On the website only: the heading of that page.
_notes.kit.get_download: On the website only, under "Use it in your school". {link} is the words "latest release" (the kit's), linked.
_notes.keys.button: Hover text of the keyboard button (in the game bar, and on the menus beside the word keys.title). It opens the list of keys.
_notes.keys.map: Read by screen readers when the map has the keyboard.
_notes.keys.hint: Shown for a few seconds at the bottom of the screen the first time a key is used in a game.
_notes.keys.unknown: Read by screen readers for a highlighted place the learner hasn't found (its name would give the answer away).
_notes.keys.k_tab: The list of keys: each k_ is the key (as printed on the keyboard), each t_ what it does.
_notes.game.back: The button that leaves the game for the menu (short: there is little room). Its hover text is game.back_hint.
_notes.menu.done: On the map menu, next to the Keyboard button: how many game modes (not Practice) have met their accuracy goal.
_notes.keys.on_menu: Heading in the list of keys, opened on a menu: the menu's keys.
_notes.keys.on_map: Heading in the list of keys, opened on the map menu: the keys for playing a map.
_notes.keys.t_close: On the website's menu, in its list of keys: what Escape does.
_notes.keys.k_skip: Skip works with . > and ; (on a French keyboard ; sits next to , and . needs Shift): show the easiest on the language's usual keyboard.
_notes.keys.k_flag: Flags mode: the key that shows the flag bigger. F and D both work in every language: show the one for the language's word (Flag, Drapeau).
_notes.keys.k_number: On the website's menu: the number keys open the set of maps with that number in its circle.

title: SINGE: Studies In Geography
description: Find regions, capitals and flags on maps.
menu.title: Choose a map
menu.no_maps: No maps found. Check the "maps" list in config.js and that the map files are included.
menu.default_only_hint: This map is not available in {language} yet.
skip.prev: Go back to the previous skipped one
prompt.practice: Practice: point at or tap a region or city to see its name.
feedback.hint: That one is highlighted - click it.
feedback.not_main: That is part of {name}, but not its main area. Click on the main area of {name}.
rotate.hint: This map is wide. Please turn your device sideways.
flag.hint: Click to see it full size
results.title: Finished!
results.not_counted: Below the {pct}% pass mark, so this round was not saved as a result.
board.africa_all: Africa: all countries and territories: regions
board.africa_all_capitals: Africa: all countries and territories: capitals
board.africa_all_flags: Africa: all countries and territories: flags
package.countries_about: Sierra Leone, the United States, the British Isles and France.
package.africa_about: Africa's countries by region (the African Union's), the whole continent, and every country and territory.
package.world_about: Every country of the world, and every territory and island.
kit.get_download: Download the sets of maps from the {link}. Each set is its own zip, and the same zip works in:
keys.title: Keyboard
keys.map: The map. Tab or the arrow keys move between places, Enter chooses. Question mark: all the keys.
keys.hint: Tab or Arrows: Move   ·   Enter: Choose   ·   ?: List of keys
keys.unknown: A place you haven't found yet
keys.t_tab: Move to the next or previous place
keys.t_arrows: Move to the nearest place in that direction
keys.t_back: Back to the one you skipped
keys.t_menu: Close a panel, or go back to the menu
keys.t_flag: Show the flag bigger (F again or Escape: close it)
keys.t_number: Open the set of maps with that number
